text:
Tara (Growth): Quick thread: proposing a small "Spark Launch" experiment — 40m hands-on workshop, 3 short launch posts, and a credit-staggering test (immediate vs delayed). Goal = bump 7-day activation. sync?
Leo (Design): Nice name. two creative riffs: "Spark: launch fast" (momentum) vs "Spark: lower your inference bill" (value). I'll sketch hero frames + a tiny benchmark vignette.
Priya (Product): Workshop format idea: 12m demo, 20m guided lab, 8m deploy-check, 0-5m Q&A. Outcome = working endpoint + 3 "prompt microkits" for different personas. attendees get starter credits.
Hector (Eng): Routing & instrumentation: add signup flag credit_arm set to NOW or LATER. Tag cohort=spark-apr. If user crosses >=1200 tokens in 7d, emit lead_event to growth-sales. Also can gate routing if sales queue > 20 leads.
reg-bot: Live form -> 47 signups in 2h, paid ad CTR 3.6% :sparkles:
Tara (Growth): Draft post copy — quick variants. edit freely:
```
Short A: "Launch an LLM feature in hours. Join our Spark Launch + claim starter credits: https://redwood.ai/spark"
Short B: "Save on inference, ship faster. Live Spark Launch + prompt microkits. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/spark"
Long: "Hands-on Spark Launch: build, deploy, and measure a small LLM feature. Attendees receive starter credits and a prompt microkit tailored to their persona. Limited seats."
```
Leo (Design): A is X-first punchy; B works for LinkedIn. I'll produce 2 hero gifs and a benchmark card comparing per-token cost and 95p latency to our baseline. Need 95p number from Hector.
Priya (Product): Experiment hypothesis: NOW increases attendance but LATER increases 7-day token activation. we'll randomize at signup and track cohorts.
Hector (Eng): Implementation note: add credit_arm in signup payload: `{\"cohort\":\"spark-apr\",\"credit_arm\":\"NOW|LATER\"}`. I'll emit analytics events for registration, attendance, credit_redemption, and 7d_token_count.
Tara (Growth): Routing rules draft (keep it lightweight):
```json
{
  "source": "spark_form",
  "tags": ["cohort:spark-apr","launch:spark"],
  "route_to": "growth-sales",
  "route_if": {"7d_tokens": ">=1200"},
  "fallback": "nurture-bundle"
}
```
Priya (Product): Add fallback nuance: if growth-sales backlog > 20, route to automated high-intent nurture + prompt microkit email.
Leo (Design): For prompt microkits I'll design 3 mini-templates: support-summary (customer support), code-spark (developer assistant), and doc-curator (knowledge extractor). each with 2 short examples.
Hector (Eng): I'll pull 50/95/99p latency and per-token cost for the small+medium models and post them here. also will wire the credit_arm randomizer and route rules before the campaign goes live.
reg-bot: Ad creative A -> CTR 4.0%, creative B -> CTR 3.2% in early sample.
Tara (Growth): Metrics we care about: registration -> attendance, attendance -> 7d tokens, activation rate (>=1200 tokens), 30d retention. Primary KPI = activation rate within 7d. Secondary = cost per activated user.
Priya (Product): I'll own agenda + prompt microkits. Leo: assets ETA?
Leo (Design): Hero gifs + benchmark card by EOD tomorrow.
Hector (Eng): Routing + metrics wired and numbers by EOD.
Tara (Growth): Action items: Leo (creative assets), Priya (agenda & microkits), Hector (routing & infra metrics), Tara (ads + measurement). Dry run 24h prior. Thanks all :thumbsup:
